note: Pasco County park (NOT the unrelated private Withlacoochee River RV Park on SR-575); RV sites #1-15 plus river tent sites, cabins and a separate hike-in primitive area. Equestrian sites are in the adjacent Green Swamp preserve, not this campground. Spacious shaded sites. Pets must stay inside the RV (dogs on a 6-ft leash may walk the park, not the tent areas). --Claude
